gloss: juice, juicy or dainty bit, dainty
definition: [ לָשָׁד ] noun masculine juice, juicy or dainty bit, dainty ; — construct כְּטַעַן לְשַׁד הַשָּׁ֑מֶן Num 11:8 ( J ) simile of taste of manna ( ᵐ5 ἐγκρίς , ᵑ9 panis oleatus ), i.e. a dainty prepared with oil (compare Di ); לְשַׁדִּי בְּחַרְבֹנֵי קַיִץ נֶהְפַּךְ Ps 32:4 my juice (sap, life-moisture) is transformed, etc.
